ticker: WELCOME TO THE 2024 B.B.G.C. — Four groups, six teams per group. Three from each group advance to the knockout round.

GROUP PLAY · ORANGE — Pure gridlock. FOUR teams finished 3-2 — White Zin, D-Boccery, Brothers Boor and Long Ballz — and the whole group came down to the points column. White Zin's 97 led the way, and Brothers Boor were the ones left out despite matching every record. WHITE ZIN, D-BOCCERY and LONG BALLZ advance.

GROUP PLAY · RED — Joanie Loves Bocce took it at 4-1. Then, naturally, another traffic jam: Hot Sauce, Hawkeyes and Tyson's Micropenis ALL 3-2, sorted on points, 76 to 75 to 64. The M.J.s went home 0-5. JOANIE LOVES BOCCE, HOT SAUCE and HAWKEYES advance.

GROUP PLAY · BLUE — The Seekers were perfect: 5-0. But look behind them — Hide Your Moms went 4-1 and racked up 101 POINTS, the biggest single-group total anywhere in the archive, and still finished second. Laces Out took third. THE SEEKERS, HIDE YOUR MOMS and LACES OUT advance.
GROUP PLAY · YELLOW — Gumby Dammit ran the table, 5-0 with 98 points. Sister Swap chased them home at 4-1, Guns n Rollers third at 3-2. GUMBY DAMMIT, SISTER SWAP and GUNS N ROLLERS advance.
ROUND ONE — Hawkeyes saw off Guns n Rollers. Hide Your Moms and those 101 points ended Laces Out. D-Boccery put out Hot Sauce. And Long Ballz upset Sister Swap. The board was set for the big seeds.

QUARTERFINALS — And one of them didn't survive it. HAWKEYES KNOCKED OUT GUMBY DAMMIT — 5-0 in the group, 98 points, gone in one game. White Zin ended the Hide Your Moms juggernaut. The Seekers put out D-Boccery, and Joanie Loves Bocce ended Long Ballz.
SEMIFINALS — White Zin stopped the Hawkeyes upset train. The Seekers turned back Joanie Loves Bocce. A team that had only gone 3-2 in its group against a team that hadn't lost at all.

THE FINAL — The Seekers: 5-0 in Blue, two clean bracket wins, unbeaten from the first ball to the last. White Zin: third-best record of the four group winners, through a four-way tiebreak just to get out of Orange — and now one win from everything.

🏆 CHAMPIONS: WHITE ZIN 🏆 — They finished 3-2. They needed a points tiebreak to even win their group. And then they beat Hide Your Moms, they beat Hawkeyes, and they beat the unbeaten The Seekers in the final. A first B.B.G.C. title — six years after losing the 2018 final. They'd been waiting.
